name: Mill Creek Packaging Inc
old_description: Keep your specialty product shipments secure with tailor-made wooden crates.
about:
Founded in 1975 in Glenview, Illinois, Mill Creek Packaging Inc began as a small operation building crates and pallets. The company relocated to its current facility in Wadsworth, Illinois in 1989, where it continues to design, build, and warehouse a range of packaging products.

Today the firm produces custom wooden crates, pallets, corrugated cartons, and foam cushioning, along with custom storage solutions such as totes, bins, and racks. Its services extend to print and artwork design, pre‑assembled packaging options, and a suite of supply‑chain programs including just‑in‑time ordering, inventory management, kanban replenishment, and warehousing. The company also offers same‑day delivery on stocked items and flexible run quantities for both domestic and export shipments.

Mill Creek serves a broad North American customer base, with noted experience in the automotive and marine sectors as well as energy equipment manufacturing. Its packaging solutions are tailored to specialty product shipments that require secure, tailored containment.

The company emphasizes personal account management and decades of hands‑on expertise as its primary differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that goes beyond standard packaging supply to provide integrated logistics support.
